name: wefunder
description: Browse Wefunder offerings and read authorized company and syndicate information; optionally follow companies for you.

interface.longDescription: Browse the startups raising on Wefunder that you can see, read a company's page and round terms as data, and, if you run a company or syndicate on Wefunder, read your investor and member data. Read by default: this connection can never invest, reserve, or move money. With permissions you grant explicitly it can follow companies for you. Wefunder does not give investment advice or recommendations.
defaultPrompt: Show Wefunder offerings with a minimum of $500 or less.
Show my syndicate's deals and recent activity.
